title: Distribute Candies
description: Given an array representing candy types, find the maximum number of unique candy types Alice can eat if she is allowed to eat n/2 candies.
pseudocode:
1. limit = candyType.length / 2
2. uniqueCandies = new Set(candyType)
3. return Math.min(uniqueCandies.size, limit)

steps.note: Calculate the limit of candies Alice can eat (length 4 / 2 = 2).
Create a Set of unique candy types: {1, 2}.
Compare set size (2) with limit (2). Return min(2, 2) = 2.
